data.name: Protovolkers
data.detailed_description:
Protovolkers is a high-speed racing game that blends arcade thrills, striking retro-futuristic visuals, and a story full of unexpected twists. Defy gravity across vibrant circuits in solo or multiplayer modes and feel the rush of pure velocity.

Main Features

  • High-Speed Racing: Built around fast-paced, adrenaline-pumping races, with vehicles pushing the limits of speed on challenging tracks that demand the maximum of your driving skills.

  • Music Integration: Strong integration of music into the gameplay with dynamic soundtracks that will enhance your racing experience.

  • Retro games & Redline-Inspired Aesthetics: The visuals are a mix of retro video game styles and the highly-saturated always-recognizable aesthetic of the Redline anime.

  • Career, Single-Player & Multiplayer Modes: Play in a variety of modes, from a story-driven career mode to single-or-multiplayer options. Play solo or compete against your friends.

  • 6 Unique Characters: Featuring distinctive characters and their respective machines, each with their own backstory, you decide who will win in the end.

  • Over 12 Circuits: Intricately designed tracks where each race presents new challenges, layouts and environments to satisfy your adrenaline addiction.

Extra Support

  • Instant language switching via keybinding to support multilingual accessibility.

  • Full gamepad support for the main gamepad models on the market.

  • Native support for Windows and Linux operating systems.

Important Note

data.short_description: Winding tracks at high speed with the wildest cast of characters in the most forgotten galaxy. What started as a morbid competition will become a fight for survival behind the wheel. An adventure with visual novel elements, all wrapped in a retro-inspired addiction for old-looking visuals and music.
